transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi… thanks for seeing me. I’m probably making it sound worse than it is, but I’ve just been really, really exhausted. Like my body feels completely drained. Even walking from my car into the clinic felt like a lot, and at work, just opening the EHR feels like it takes everything I have. I figured I should come in and ask about it, if that’s okay.
How long have you been feeling this level of exhaustion?

Um… it’s been longer than I probably should’ve let it go. I think about nine months, since after I kind of crashed from this really high-energy stretch. Since then it’s been this low, guilty, exhausted feeling most of the time. Is that the kind of timeframe you mean?
Do you have any muscle pain?
Um… not really, no. I mean, I get tired and kind of heavy-feeling, but I haven’t noticed actual muscle pain, if that makes sense. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time since you've been experiencing this exhaustion?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but after all that energy dropped off, I’ve felt pretty empty most days. Kind of hopeless, like I already messed up my future in healthcare before I even really got started. Is that… the kind of “down” you’re asking about?
Have you been enjoying things you used to like during this time?

Um… I’m not totally sure how to answer that. I mean, I still try to do things I used to like, but it’s harder to tell if I’m actually enjoying them or just kind of going through the motions. I don’t want to overstate it, but… yeah, it hasn’t felt the same. Is that what you mean?
Have you had thoughts of death or suicide since you've been feeling this way?

I… don’t think so. Not in a serious way, anyway. Like, I’ve felt really low and kind of wished I could just not deal with everything for a while, but I’m not sitting there making plans or anything. I’m sorry, is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you experienced a loss of interest in activities you normally enjoy most of the time since you've been feeling exhausted?

I guess I’m not totally sure it’s a full loss of interest. I still kind of want to like those things, and sometimes I’ll start them because I feel like I should… but it doesn’t really click the same. So, maybe yes, but I don’t want to say it wrong. Does that count?
Have you experienced a significant decrease in appetite or weight loss since you started feeling this way?

Um… yeah, I guess there has been. I didn’t really think of it as a big thing at first, but I haven’t been wanting food much. Like I’d skip lunch and sometimes dinner, and then just have coffee or water. I noticed my scrubs were kind of hanging looser on me, so… I guess that counts as weight loss?
Have you had any periods where you felt somewhat better, even for a few weeks, since this exhaustion started?

I’m not sure… I mean, maybe for like a day here and there I’d feel a little more okay, but I don’t think there were weeks where I felt properly better. It’s kind of been hanging around. Is that what you mean?
Have you experienced any periods where your symptoms were significantly worse than they are now?

I guess… not really worse than at the beginning, if that makes sense. The really low, guilty, exhausted part has kind of been going on since I crashed after that really high-energy time… about nine months now. It’s been pretty consistently bad, I think. I don’t know if that answers it the right way.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt no sadness at all?

Not really, no. I mean… I don’t want to sound dramatic, but most days I feel pretty empty or hopeless. Since all that energy dropped off, it’s like I keep thinking I’ve already messed up my future in healthcare before I even really got started. Maybe there are moments I’m distracted, but I don’t think there’s been a whole day with no sadness. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?

I’m not sure… I mean, I still try to do things, like watch something or be around people a bit, and maybe it distracts me for a little while. But I don’t know if I’d call it pleasure exactly. It’s more like… I’m going through the motions, I guess. Is that the kind of answer you’re looking for?
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt nearly back to your normal self?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, maybe I’ve had little stretches where I seemed okay on the outside, but not a whole day where I felt like myself again. Since that energy dropped off, it’s mostly been this empty, hopeless feeling… like I’ve already ruined my future in healthcare before I even got started. I’m sorry, I don’t know if that’s the kind of answer you mean.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt significantly better than you do most days?

Maybe a little better here and there, but not like a whole day, no. Most days since all that energy kind of dropped off, I’ve felt pretty empty… hopeless, I guess. I keep thinking I already messed up my future in healthcare before I even really got started. So, I mean, I can have moments where I’m not as bad, but I wouldn’t say significantly better. Does that make sense?
Would you say that your feelings of emptiness and hopelessness are present every day?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but since that energy kind of dropped off, it’s been there most days. The emptiness and the hopelessness… especially the thought that I’ve already ruined my future in healthcare before it even really started. It’s hard to shake. Does that answer it okay?
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now find you no longer take pleasure in?

Um… I’m not totally sure. I mean, I haven’t really been paying close attention to what I enjoy, if that makes sense. I guess some things feel harder to get into lately, but I don’t know if I’d say I no longer take pleasure in them.

Sorry, is that the kind of thing you mean?
Are there things you used to enjoy that you no longer enjoy at all?

I don’t think there’s anything I enjoy… like, zero enjoyment at all. It’s more like I don’t really feel motivated to do much, or it takes more effort to get into things. But if something distracts me for a bit, I can still have a moment where it’s okay, I guess.

Is that a clear answer?
Have you felt this way for most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two weeks?

I’m not sure I can say that exactly. It’s been around a lot, but I haven’t really tracked whether it’s most of the day every day for two weeks. Some parts of the day are better if I’m distracted, I think.

Is that okay to say?
Have you been feeling sad, empty, or hopeless for at least two weeks straight?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t want to make it sound more dramatic than it is, but after all that energy kind of dropped, I started feeling pretty empty and hopeless most days.

It’s like… I kept thinking I’d already messed up my future in healthcare before I’d even really started. It’s been around for at least a couple weeks, I think. Is that what you mean?
Have you been feeling sad, empty, or hopeless most days for the past nine months?

I’m not sure I can honestly say the whole nine months. I don’t want to overstate it.

But after that energy dropped, yeah… I started feeling empty and hopeless most days, like I’d already ruined my future in healthcare before it even really started. I’m just not totally sure about the exact length of time. Is that okay?
